text:
morgan: quick shoutout — alejandro stayed late to help katie with the embedding drift that broke the demo this morning. demo back up, client happy. :tada:
katie: omg yes THANK YOU alejandro!!! you saved my day. seriously couldn't have pushed the demo without you. :heart:
alejandro: hey no worries, team effort. traced it to a stale prefix cache returning old vectors. flushed cache + redeploy, all green now. :white_check_mark:
simone: absolute legend. also big thanks to ops-bot for the early alert so we could jump on it quickly :pray:
ops-bot: incident: embeddings-service returned anomalous similarity scores. auto-rollout paused at 09:12 UTC. Resolved by redeploy at 09:41 UTC. Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/embeddings/1864002222
morgan: love to reward this energy — suggest we drop a box of donuts in the kitchen for alejandro + katie? who's in? :doughnut:
ben: count me in :+1:
katie: i'll bring napkins and tiny flags for the donuts 😀
alejandro: haha i'm embarrassed but accept. thanks everyone 🙏
lina: also quick follow-up: i'll write a 3-line blurb for #incidents so we have a record, and add the cache step to the runbook. putting a draft in #eng-docs in a bit.
morgan: perfect, thanks lina. high fives all around. :raised_hands:
